_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, manufacturing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services for many different types of computing devices'; 'Challenges to our business model may reduce our revenues and operating margins': 'Certain “open source” software business models challenge our license-based software model', and 'Another development is the business model under which companies provide content, and software in the form of applications, data, and related services, over the Internet in exchange for revenues primarily from advertising or subscriptions'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2009 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, manufacturing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products and services for many different types of computing devices'; 'Challenges to our business model may reduce our revenues and operating margins': 'Certain “open source” software business models challenge our license-based software model', and 'Another development is the business model under which companies provide content, and software in the form of applications, data, and related services, over the Internet in exchange for revenues primarily from advertising or subscriptions'; 'We face intense competition' (its own FY2009 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.36x; -0% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +1.79; conservative 2yr +55%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -30.4%/yr (worst year FY00-FY09, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +16.3%/yr (Q2 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.3%/yr (FY00-FY09 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY00-FY09); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2010-04-16) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.36x (60.9% downside to Bear $12 / +170.6% upside to Bull $83) | Adj composite 3.44 vs market 1.65: gap +1.79 [UNDERVALUED] | -0% above the EPP floor $31 (19x FY10E $1.62) | Conservative 2-yr case: +55.4% total (+27.7%/yr) | At 18.9x FY10E the 15% hurdle price $41 sits at or below the BASE case; unearned revenue -4.1% in Q2 FY10, forward revenues +14% (no Q3 FY10 revenue guide, Q2 FY10 revenue ex-currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
